question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.

Jintu is such a _______ (funny) person.
solution:
The correct answer is: **humorous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"funny"** refers to something that causes laughter or amusement. (मजेदार)
 
 
• **Example:** The comedian told a funny story that made the entire audience laugh.
 
 
 
• The word **"humorous"** means being amusing, funny, or entertaining in a way that evokes laughter or enjoyment. (हास्यपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** His humorous remarks kept the audience entertained throughout the evening.
 
 
 
• Since "humorous" closely aligns with the meaning of "funny," it is the most appropriate synonym to fill the blank in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **humorous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bad** (खराब): Of poor quality or low standard.
 
 
• **Example:** The food tasted bad because it was overcooked.
 
 
 
• **Tall** (लंबा): Having a relatively great height.
 
 
• **Example:** The tall building could be seen from miles away.
 
 
 
• **Cold** (ठंडा): Of or at a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a cold winter morning, and snow covered the streets.
